sections.title: 一、阅读理解 A
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面的语言材料, 从每题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Hi! I'm Jack Smith. I'm twelve years old. I have a sister. Her name is Mary Smith. She is ten years old.

My first name is Bill, and my last name is Green. You can call (称呼) me Bill or Bill Green. But you can't call me Green.

Hello! I'm Zhang Mingming. Mingming is my first name and Zhang is my last name. I'm a Chinese boy, so my name is different from an English name.

Hi! My name is Jim Brown. I'm thirteen years old. I have a brother. His name is Danny. He is thirteen too. We are twins.

questions.translation: 玛丽·史密斯是杰克的妹妹。
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“Hi! I'm Jack Smith... I have a sister. Her name is Mary Smith.”可知，Mary Smith是Jack的妹妹。故选 Jack's sister。

questions.prompt: 2. The name ________ is different from the other names.
questions.translation: 张明明这个名字与其他名字不同。
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“I'm a Chinese boy, so my name is different from an English name.”可知，Zhang Mingming是中文名（姓在前，名在后），其余三项均为英文名（名在前，姓在后）。故选 Zhang Mingming。
根据第四段“My name is Jim Brown... I have a brother. His name is Danny... We are twins.”可知，Jim和Danny是双胞胎兄弟，因此Danny的姓氏也是Brown。故选 Brown。

questions.prompt: 4. The name ________ is a wrong(错误的) name.
questions.explanation: 英文名字的正确顺序是“名在前，姓在后（First name + Last name）”，Jack是名，Smith是姓，正确形式应为Jack Smith，而Smith Jack颠倒了顺序是错误的。故选 Smith Jack。

sections.title: 二、阅读理解 B
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面的语言材料, 从每题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
My name is Makiy. I am twelve years old. I am not from England. I am from Japan. I'm Japanese. But now I live in Shanghai. I am in Shanghai Middle School. I'm in Class Five, Grade Seven. I have many friends.

Linda and Jack are my good friends. Linda is thirteen years old and Jack is twelve years old. Linda likes dancing and Jack likes football and basketball. Do you know my hobby? I like watching television. My favourite sport is swimming.

questions.explanation: 根据第一段“I am not from England. I am from Japan. I'm Japanese.”可知，Makiy来自日本。故选 She is from Japan.。
根据第一段“But now I live in Shanghai.”可知，她现在住在上海。故选 In Shanghai.。
根据第二段“Linda and Jack are my good friends.”可知，Linda是Makiy的好朋友。故选 friend。

questions.prompt: 8. After reading the passage, we can know ________.
questions.translation: 读完短文后，我们可以知道杰克喜欢篮球。
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“Jack likes football and basketball.”可知Jack喜欢篮球。其他选项：Makiy喜欢看电视和游泳，Linda十三岁，Jack十二岁。故选 Jack likes basketball。

sections.title: 三、阅读理解 C
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面的语言材料, 从每题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
I'm Mrs. Zhou. I'm a teacher in No. 1 Middle School. This is Li Lei. He's Chinese. He is in Class 2, Grade 7. He's my student, and my son too. He is twelve. That girl is Jean. She's American. She's eleven. And that boy is Jack. He's English. He's ten. They're in Li Lei's class.

I'm their Chinese teacher. All the students and the teachers have two names: an English name and a Chinese name. Li Lei's English name is Tom. My English name is Mary. Their English teacher is Miss Jin. Her English name is Sue. Jean's and Jack's Chinese names are Wei Hua and Zhang Li.

questions.explanation: 根据第一段“This is Li Lei... He is twelve.”可知李雷12岁。故选 twelve。
根据第二段最后一句“Jean's and Jack's Chinese names are Wei Hua and Zhang Li.”可知，Jean对应的中文名是Wei Hua。故选 Wei Hua。
根据第一段“And that boy is Jack. He's English.”可知Jack是英国人。故选 English。

questions.prompt: 12. Which one is NOT true according to the passage?
options: Li Lei is Mrs. Zhou's son.
Jean and Jack are in Li Lei's class.
Miss Jin's English name is Sue.
Mrs. Zhou is an English teacher.
questions.translation: 根据短文内容，哪一项是不正确的？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段开头“I'm their Chinese teacher.”可知周老师是语文老师，而不是英语老师（英语老师是Miss Jin），因此D项表述错误。故选 Mrs. Zhou is an English teacher.。

sections.title: 四、阅读理解 D
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面的语言材料, 从每题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
# My Good Friends

Hello! My name is Tina. I'm twelve years old. I come from the US, but I'm in China now. I study in an international(国际的) middle school in Shanghai. I am in Class Four. I make some good friends in this school. They come from different countries and they look different as well. They are friendly to me. I want to introduce(介绍) some of them today.

**Steven** He is from America. He is thirteen years old and he is in Class One. He likes to eat fruit and drink milk. He is good at basketball.

**Jane** She comes from China. She and I are of the same age. She is in Class Two. Her favourite food is hot pot. She likes music and she plays the guitar in the school band. She is kind and beautiful.

**Jenny** She is an English girl. She is thirteen years old and she is in Class Four. We are classmates. She likes eating ice-cream and hamburgers. She likes playing tennis.

**Jack** He and I come from the same country. He is the same age as me. He is in Class Four, too. He likes eating vegetables and apples. Red is his favourite colour.

questions.explanation: 根据第一段“I come from the US, but I'm in China now.”可知Tina来自美国。故选 the US。
根据关于Steven的介绍“He likes to eat fruit and drink milk.”可知Steven喜欢吃水果。故选 fruit。
根据第一段“My name is Tina. I'm twelve years old.”以及关于Jack的介绍“He is the same age as me.”可知，Jack和Tina同龄，也是12岁。故选 twelve。

questions.prompt: 16. There is/are ________ student(s) in Class Four in this passage.
questions.translation: 这篇文章中在四班的学生有三位。
questions.explanation: 文中在四班的学生包括：Tina（“I am in Class Four”）、Jenny（“she is in Class Four. We are classmates”）以及Jack（“He is in Class Four, too”），共有3名学生。故选 three。

sections.title: 五、阅读还原
sections.instruction: 第二节 阅读短文, 从方框所给的选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项, 其中有一个多余的选项。
sections.passage:
Mr. White is an Englishman. He comes from London. [17] His English classes are very interesting. He is good to us and often helps us with our English. [18]

[19] Eric is fourteen years old and his sister Lucy is only three. Eric goes to school but Lucy doesn't. Eric is smart and Lucy looks beautiful.

Mr. White likes wearing T-shirts, jeans and sports shoes. He likes running, [20] After school, we often have a basketball match. Sometimes Mr. White joins(加入) us. He plays basketball just for fun.
wordbank: A. Mr. White has two children, Eric and Lucy.
C. He likes us and we like him, too.
D. but basketball is his favourite sport and he plays it very well.
E. Now he works in our school and teaches English.

questions.translation: 现在他在我们学校工作并教英语。
questions.explanation: 后句紧接着提到“His English classes are very interesting.”，因此前面介绍“Now he works in our school and teaches English.”（现在他在我们学校工作教英语）承上启下，故选 E项。

questions.translation: 他喜欢我们，我们也喜欢他。
questions.explanation: 前句提到“He is good to us and often helps us with our English.”，此处总结师生关系融洽“He likes us and we like him, too.”（他喜欢我们，我们也喜欢他），故选 C项。

questions.translation: 怀特先生有两个孩子，埃里克和露西。
questions.explanation: 第二段后文详细介绍了“Eric is fourteen years old and his sister Lucy is only three.”，因此段首总起句应为“Mr. White has two children, Eric and Lucy.”，故选 A项。

questions.translation: ……但篮球是他最喜欢的运动，而且他打得非常好。
questions.explanation: 前文提到“He likes running,”，后文提到“After school, we often have a basketball match. Sometimes Mr. White joins us.”，因此用“but basketball is his favourite sport and he plays it very well.”转折并引出下文打篮球的情境，故选 D项。

sections.title: 六、完形填空
sections.instruction: 二、完形填空 阅读短文, 理解其大意, 从A、B、C三个选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项。
sections.passage:
My name is Ronald. [21] 24 years old, and I'm the manager of a [22] shop. We carry all kinds of cats, dogs, snakes, birds and fish. We [23] have one snake that is about four meters long, but I keep him at home. As for my [24], I like to fish and ride horses in my free time. My favourite foods [25] beef, potatoes and apples. I like reading novels, [26] I don't enjoy reading poems. I have two brothers. [27] of them are college students. And I have [28] dogs, Brutus, Charlie and Samantha. They like bones and I feed [29] bones every day. They [30] cute.

Please write to me.

Yours, Ronald

questions.explanation: 全文以第一人称Ronald自述，介绍自己的年龄用I'm。故选 I'm。
根据后文“We carry all kinds of cats, dogs, snakes, birds and fish.”（我们有各种猫、狗、蛇、鸟和鱼）可知这是一家宠物店（pet shop）。故选 pet。

questions.translation: 我们甚至有一条大约四米长的蛇……
questions.explanation: even意为“甚至”，用于递进强调蛇的长度达四米之长。故选 even。
根据后文“I like to fish and ride horses in my free time.”可知提到了钓鱼和骑马两个爱好，应用复数hobbies。故选 hobbies。

questions.translation: 我最喜欢的食物是牛肉、土豆和苹果。
questions.explanation: 主语My favourite foods是复数，be动词用are。故选 are。

questions.translation: 我喜欢读小说，但我不喜欢读诗歌。
questions.explanation: 喜欢读小说与不喜欢读诗歌之间是转折关系，用连词but。故选 but。
前句提到“I have two brothers.”，指代两者都用Both（Both of them）。故选 Both。

questions.translation: 并且我有三条狗，布鲁特斯、查理和萨曼莎。
questions.explanation: 根据后文列举的三条狗的名字“Brutus, Charlie and Samantha”可知共有3条狗。故选 three。

questions.translation: 它们喜欢骨头，我每天喂它们骨头。
questions.explanation: 动词feed后接人称代词宾格指代复数的dogs，用them（feed them bones）。故选 them。
主语They是第三人称复数，be动词用are。故选 are。

sections.title: 七、语篇填空
sections.instruction: 三、语篇填空 阅读短文, 在空白处填入一个适当的单词或用括号内所给单词的正确形式填空, 使短文通顺、连贯。
sections.passage: Hello, I'm Paul. Dale [31] (be) my classmate. We are in the same middle school, but we love different [32] (sport). Dale likes basketball. He thinks it's fun. He has [33] basketball. It's in [34] (he) bag. He always [35] (play) basketball at school, [36] I don't like basketball. I think it's boring. I love volleyball and I have two volleyballs. [37] class, I always play it [38] my friends. It's relaxing for [39] (I). I love baseball, [40] but I don't play baseball. I only watch baseball games on TV. It's great for me.

questions.explanation: 主语Dale是第三人称单数，一般现在时be动词用is。故选 is。
different修饰可数名词复数，sport变复数sports。故选 sports。
basketball此处表示具体的篮球实物，为可数名词单数，且发音以辅音音素开头，用不定冠词a。故选 a。
修饰名词bag需要用形容词性物主代词his。故选 his。
频度副词always提示一般现在时，主语He为第三人称单数，动词play加s变为plays。故选 plays。
前面讲Dale总打篮球，后面讲作者不喜欢篮球，前后句构成转折关系，用连词but。故选 but。

questions.translation: 下课后，我总是和朋友们一起打排球。
questions.explanation: after class为常用介词短语，意为“下课后”，句首首字母大写为After。故选 After。

questions.translation: ……我总是和朋友们一起打排球。
questions.explanation: play sth. with sb.表示“与某人一起做某项运动/游戏”，with意为“和……一起”。故选 with。
介词for后接人称代词宾格me。故选 me。

questions.prompt: 40. I love baseball, ______ but I don't play baseball.
questions.translation: 我也喜欢棒球，但我并不打棒球。
questions.explanation: 根据上下文，前面提到喜欢排球，此处表示“我也喜欢棒球”，肯定句句末用副词too。故选 too,。

sections.title: 八、阅读与表达
sections.instruction: 四、阅读与表达 阅读短文, 然后根据内容选择最佳答案或回答问题。
sections.passage:
I'm Liu Min. Anna is my English name. I'm a Chinese girl. I'm 13 years old. I like sports. Baseball is my favourite sport and I think it's interesting. I play baseball with my friend every day.

Cindy is my classmate. She's an English girl. She's 12 years old. She doesn't like playing baseball. She thinks it's boring. Her favourite sport is volleyball. And she's good at playing it. She often plays volleyball with her two brothers. I don't like playing volleyball. I think it's difficult.

Miss White is our English teacher. She likes sports, too. She plays soccer well. She often plays soccer with us after school. She's a good teacher. We like her very much.

questions.translation: 刘敏最喜欢的运动是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“Baseball is my favourite sport and I think it's interesting.”可知刘敏最喜欢棒球。故选 Baseball.。
根据第二段“Cindy is my classmate... She's 12 years old.”可知Cindy十二岁。故选 12 years old.。

questions.prompt: 43. Who is Liu Min's English teacher?
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“Miss White is our English teacher.”可知刘敏的英语老师是怀特老师。故选 Miss White.。

questions.prompt: 44. What's your favourite sport? Why? (30 words or more)
options: My favourite sport is tennis. I often play tennis with my classmates after school every day. Some of my classmates are good at playing tennis, and I like to play it with them. I think it is fun and good for my health.
I don't like any sports because I think sports are very boring and tiring for middle school students.
My favourite sport is sleeping at home because I like to stay in bed and watch TV with my pets.
My favourite sport is reading English books in the classroom every day with my teachers.
questions.translation: 你最喜欢的运动是什么？为什么？（30词以上）
questions.explanation: 根据题目要求表达自己最喜欢的运动及原因，选项A言之有理、符合字数与语言表达规范。故选 My favourite sport is tennis. I often play tennis with my classmates after school every day. Some of my classmates are good at playing tennis, and I like to play it with them. I think it is fun and good for my health.。
